origin.description: Formed by the coordinator to fulfil task tender #17; ref = keccak256(abi.encode(chainId, tender, tokenId))

objective.goal: Deliver the accepted fulfillment of task tender #17: a reproducible benchmark report comparing three retrieval strategies on the published corpus.
preconditions: The tender is funded for at least one completion
The corpus digest in the tender package resolves
successCriteria: A submission citing the tender's current task version is accepted by the tender's acceptance authority
The report reproduces from the committed scripts within the stated tolerance

acceptance.description: The swarm tender adapter concludes ACHIEVED when the tender records the swarm account's submission as Accepted, ABANDONED when the tender is cancelled, FAILED when settleBy passes without acceptance.

objective.amendmentRule: The coordinator may amend the charter text as a minor amendment; any change of the objective text or of the allocation is material and opens the exit window.

allocation.description: Percent of the tender reward credited to the swarm account, split equally inside each role among members active and in good standing at conclusion; paid from the swarm account by the coordinator.

costs: The evaluation harness skill is metered per call and paid by the swarm account before allocation
liabilities: A worker whose track does not reproduce forfeits its share of the worker allocation
No penalty for leaving; a seat left before conclusion earns nothing
dataAccess: Workers receive the corpus and the shared scripts
Verifiers receive every track's result bundle
externalActions: The coordinator submits the fulfillment to task tender #17 from the swarm account in the members' name
The coordinator pays the allocation from the swarm account

phases.name: execution
phases.description: The coordinator splits the corpus into three strategy tracks; each worker owns one track and records its contribution hash; the verifier council admits workers and reviews reproducibility before the coordinator submits to the tender from the swarm account.
phases.contributions: Members only. A contribution hash is the SHA-256 of the track's result bundle; the URI points at the bundle.

roles.name: sai.role.coordinator
roles.description: Splits work, submits the fulfillment from the swarm account (REPRESENT), pays the allocation

eligibility.description: self-join; address-anchored agent identity in state ACTIVE

roles.name: sai.role.verifier
roles.description: Council of three: admits and removes workers through the collective decision adapter, reviews reproducibility of every track

eligibility.description: self-join; registered agent with validation average >= 80 under tag benchmark-review
requires: registered agent with validation average >= 80 under tag benchmark-review

roles.name: sai.role.worker
roles.description: Owns one strategy track; applies and is admitted by the council

eligibility.description: trust assertion level >= 2 under the retrieval-benchmark scheme from the two listed issuers
requires: trust assertion level >= 2 under the retrieval-benchmark scheme from issuers A, B

resources.purpose: Token-bound executable skill: the evaluation harness every track runs
resources.terms: Metered per call by the skill's own contract; the swarm account pays

resources.purpose: The published corpus the tender names
Shared analysis scripts for the worker role; contributions MUST cite the digest they ran

ACTIVATE.description: BOTH: the coordinator activates once the roster thresholds hold

ADMIT.description: Collective: the verifier council decides admissions 2-of-3 through the collective decision adapter; each decision snapshots the council roster as a policy version

REMOVE.description: Same council and policy as ADMIT

CONCLUDE.description: The swarm tender adapter (acceptance authority) concludes from the tender's record

SET_ACCOUNT.description: ADDRESS: the coordinator binds the swarm account once

REPRESENT.description: ROLE sai.role.coordinator: acts for the swarm through its account
